hook: A 1994 legal agreement just forced a major television studio trial.

sections.voiceover: A 1994 legal agreement just forced a major television studio trial.

In November 2026, a California appeals court ruled Warner Bros. Television must face a jury trial. Sherri Crichton filed the lawsuit over similarities between The Pitt and ER. Does the new show violate those protected rights?
Except a three-judge panel issued a unanimous 33-page opinion against them.
The L.A. Superior Court will now hear this case in its entirety. Warner Bros. The estate successfully argued that the 1994 rights provision was violated.
The 33-page court opinion confirms the case is moving forward.
